m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Whu! Monsieur Bat, we should be friends, no? I do not like Medulla any more than you do. I know he was the one who stole my umbrella! Whu! Whu!
Haha! We've got the Cabal on its heels! Remember how I said we'd be formidable force if we just worked together? How right was I, eh?
That'll do, Pig. That'll do. Luckily for us, Medulla's mind-meddle trick doesn't appear to be an effective long-term motivational technique.
Wizard, show Pork how to use the Eye Control Console, then meet me in the Central Axon. I'll go ensure the coast is clear.
Woah! Sepidious is slowing down... slowing... sloooowwwing... We've stopped! Just like I'd planned.
I sure hope Beans and Sparck are doing alright at their posts. If only we had some type of interpersonal communication device...
Nonetheless, I'll protect this Console with my life, Wizard. You join Bat and finish the job. Good luck, my friend. Good luck.
Well, this is definitely the door to the Central Axon Headquarters, but I'm afraid it's locked. However, there is this big button.
I figured I should wait for you before I pushed it. What's the worst that could happen, right?
We have to get in there and close Sepidious' Right Eye before the Cabal resumes normal patrols.
I'll cover our six, make sure no Cabalists get the drop on us. Good luck, team!
Alright, Wizard. Let's put this baby to sleep.
No time to chat. Eyes on the prize... which in this case, is the Right Eye.
